description: Source code for the DrmManager class handling DRM operations such as license management, decryption sessions, plugin loading, and metrics collection in an Android environment.

classes.name: DrmManager
classes.description: Main class managing DRM operations including license handling, decryption sessions, plugin management, and metrics.

classes.name: DecryptHandle
classes.description: Structure representing a decryption session handle.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Retrieves DRM constraints for a given content path and action.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a DRM-protected content.

methods.name: canHandle
methods.description: Checks if a plugin can handle a specific content path and MIME type.

methods.name: processDrmInfo
methods.description: Processes DRM information requests.

methods.name: acquireDrmInfo
methods.description: Acquires DRM information based on a request.

methods.name: saveRights
methods.description: Saves rights/licenses for DRM content.

methods.name: getOriginalMimeType
methods.description: Gets the original MIME type of a DRM content.

methods.name: getDrmObjectType
methods.description: Returns the DRM object type for a content.

methods.name: checkRightsStatus
methods.description: Checks the rights status for a content.

methods.name: consumeRights
methods.description: Consumes rights/licenses for a content.

methods.name: setPlaybackStatus
methods.description: Sets playback status for a decryption handle.

methods.name: validateAction
methods.description: Validates if an action is permitted on a content.

methods.name: removeRights
methods.description: Removes rights/licenses for a content.

methods.name: removeAllRights
methods.description: Removes all rights/licenses for the given DRM session.

methods.name: openConvertSession
methods.description: Opens a data conversion session for DRM content.

methods.name: convertData
methods.description: Converts DRM data within a session.

methods.name: closeConvertSession
methods.description: Closes a data conversion session.

methods.name: getAllSupportInfo
methods.description: Retrieves support info for all loaded DRM plugins.

methods.name: openDecryptSession
methods.description: Opens a decryption session for content.

methods.name: closeDecryptSession
methods.description: Closes an active decryption session.

methods.name: initializeDecryptUnit
methods.description: Initializes a decrypt unit within a session.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of content.

methods.name: finalizeDecryptUnit
methods.description: Finalizes a decrypt unit.

methods.name: pread
methods.description: Reads decrypted data from a session.

methods.name: getSupportedPlugInId
methods.description: Returns plugin ID supporting given MIME type or content path.

methods.name: getSupportedPlugInIdFromPath
methods.description: Returns plugin ID supporting a specific file suffix and handle.

methods.name: onInfo
methods.description: Handles DRM info events and notifies registered listeners.
